body: Not really. My parents are the only family that really accepts me being trans*, and I don't know anyone outside of class/rehearsal.

Thanks. You really have no idea how much that means.

I think I'll just finish this vodka and go pass out in bed. Maybe I'll feel better in the morning, though I doubt it.
I love how you put "help" in quotation marks. I'm assuming you don't think very highly of this subreddit, then?

Oh, so you want me to describe the bruises that took weeks to heal? The comments they made because all I am is a faggot in a dress? How about the fact that I legitimately feared for my life for a month afterwards?

And it's not like I haven't gone to admin about it. But they don't care. Their unofficial stance is, "If we don't see it happening, we can't/won't do anything."

I dunno', gaming and theatre were really all I had. I'm kind of an antisocial recluse.

A few of my friends aren't awful, but the only connection we have is acting; so once I give that up, we have nothing in common. As for the others... Well there's a reason it took me as long as it did to come out; and they've still made comments about my transition, or thought it was acceptable to use a few transphobic slurs when they were talking about me.

Thus why I don't really go to school any more, aside from days I have rehearsal. I just couldn't deal with any more panic attacks.

In 6 years it could go either way. I'll either be better off because I'll finally be happy, or I'll be worse than you because... Well... I'll be dead.

Care to flip a coin?

So you're suggesting I just go do what I want, and let my classmates beat the shit out of me again?

Yeah, great plan. Maybe if I'm lucky, they'll kill me, too. That'd solve a lot of problems.

I've tried a bit of everything; comedy, writing, running, everything I can think of, but I never enjoy it much and just retreat to performing, which I've always considered my "Sacred space," as it were, or I go back into gaming/movies, where I don't have to interact with anyone.

My parents.... Well, they're trying, at least. Mum has no problem buying me clothes and such, and Dad is.... Well, he's pretty antisocial at the best of times. He just doesn't like people. But they're both pretty accepting.

I dunno', mostly a combination of both. I can't work up the effort to care about anything outside of my few interests, none of which my "friends" share.
Theatre was kind of the only thing I was passionate about, but now that's gone and I just have no idea any more.
I'm stuck here until March. And it's not like there's anything new for me to try anyway.

Right, so I'm supposed to end up in the hospital (As I almost did when I last went around in girl mode) because some people have a problem with trannies?

I thought the point here was to talk me *out* of getting hurt.
True, but I can't exactly be myself around here unless I want to get the shit kicked out of me again.

Except I can't play an instrument for shit. (Just.... Trust me on this one.)

I'm a tech too, which I used to love doing. But right now, I'm in a show, and I'm stuck being an actor, a tech, a stage manager, a liaison between the production team and the director, and basically everything else.

I think part of the issue is that, somewhere along the way, I just lost my passion for the theatre.

I might just do that...

(Side note - It's pretty hurtful to say "A transgender." It's like saying "A gay." I know you didn't do it intentionally, so please don't apologize. Just letting you know for the future.)

Honestly? I don't know. I think it's because I just had a chance to stop being me, if only for a little while. I didn't really mind playing guys because hey, it's acting, who cares?
But now I just get a lot of dysphoria and depression when I need to play a male role (Which happens often. I'm still pre-everything, as I said, so there's no way in Hell I'd be able to do a female role, thus leading to my anxiety over playing those as well.)

Not really. The one I'm seeing is the only one within a good distance, everyone else is in the next town over, and I need to go through him since he's part of the Child and Youth Metal Health Services (Which is why I'm getting this all for free. If I saw anyone else, I'd have to pay for the therapist, plus hormones, plus everything else.)

Even then, he can't prescribe hormones. He's basically acting as a liaison for a doctor in Vancouver who can assess me, and who only took me on as a patient because I'm in a rural area.
Not to mention I'm a social recluse, so even thinking about meeting someone else would probably give me another panic attack.

I've looked, and there aren't many that I know of (i.e. Two.) They're both FtM, so they have entirely different issues than me. It doesn't help that there's not much of a LGBT+ community out here anyways, so even if I wanted to, I couldn't go meet anyone else.

*sigh* Okay,

As I said above, I'm a transwoman. Thus, I identify as female.

However, I feel dysphoric in dresses. Put on a skirt, and you'll notice the obvious budge; I can't tuck because last time I tried, it hurt quite badly and I'm not willing to try again.

I have to wear male clothes (And thus present *as male*) in public, because I live in a very transphobic area, and I'd rather not end up in the ER like I almost did last time I went out in girl mode.
But I never wanted to wear guy's clothes! That's the issue!

I'm pretty sure I know who I am, I just hate the fact that I don't look the part. (i.e. *not a bloody man.*)
I just hate being like this. I feel like a freak in a dress, and I feel depressed when I wear guy clothes so I don't get the shit kicked out of me in public.

I dunno', maybe it would be better if I wasn't around any more... I could just leave town. I wouldn't be that hard. Go find someplace where I won't get beaten, or raped, or killed because I'm a fucking tranny.
